falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, proving this was not a bottom formation but rather a continuation pattern or false bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme fear would contradict the blowoff score of 39 (which typically signals capitulation exhaustion); this would indicate the blowoff was incomplete and lower prices are still to come

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A renewed rates spike would invalidate the bottom thesis by reintroducing the primary macro headwind that caused the August 2024 decline, proving the pattern match failed due to changing fundamental conditions

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
